What We Do

Barriers, prevention & treatment — customized to your home

Our system of mechanical barriers prevents the entry of unwanted pests, working in harmony with regular pest control service to ultimately rid your home or business of unwanted critters. We never require annual contracts — we work with you to customize a plan tailored to your specific needs.

Residential Pest Control

Get those pests and bugs out of the house! Our residential packages — both exterior and interior — get the job done. Termites, scorpions, ants, rodents: we’ve got you covered, without locking you into a contract.

Scorpion & Desert Pests

Crickets, roaches, rats, mice, ants, spiders, and scorpions — the desert pests that slip through the smallest gaps. Our barrier system stops them at the door.

Rodent Control

Rats and mice in the attic or walls? We remove them and seal the entry points so they stay out — part of a customized plan for your home.

Weed Control

Be weed-free for up to six months. Pre-emergent treatment stops weeds before they start, and post-emergent treatment tackles the ones already there. Pet-friendly once dry.

Meet Your Specialists

Your pest & weed control specialists

We are a family-owned and operated company dedicated to removing unwanted guests from your home and building. Our system of mechanical barriers prevents the entry of pests such as crickets, roaches, rats, mice, ants, spiders, and scorpions — working in harmony with regular pest control service to ultimately rid your home or business of unwanted critters.

  • Monthly, bi-monthly, and quarterly programs for residential and commercial customers
  • Termite prevention and control services
  • Customized plans — never an annual contract you didn’t ask for
  • Safe and environmentally friendly — the safest approach to solving your pest problem
